name: mermaid
description: Render diagrams via Mermaid.js. Foundry built-in: markdown-it outputs code.mermaid elements; mermaid shortcode outputs same format. mermaid-render.js is a classic script (no type=module / no CORS issue on theme CDN) that dynamically import()s Mermaid 10 ESM from jsDelivr only when diagrams exist.

params.description: Additional CSS class on the <pre class='mermaid'> wrapper

js.note: DOM scanner + classic-script host; Mermaid lib via dynamic import(). Never modify.
Local fallback only. mermaid-render.js loads Mermaid 10 ESM via dynamic import() (jsDelivr has CORS).

assets.size_impact: ~1KB local (mermaid-render.js). Mermaid library (~900KB) loaded from CDN only on pages with diagrams.
assets.cdn_note: mermaid-render.js is a classic script; Mermaid lib uses dynamic import() of ESM from jsDelivr. Override mermaid-render.js to switch CDN URL.

locked.reason: mermaid-render.js implements the zero-cost lazy load contract. Modifying may break lazy loading.

css_in_main.note: Add .mermaid styles to main.css for background, border, padding of diagram blocks

partials.note: Override to empty file to disable Mermaid entirely
Override to change the pre.mermaid wrapper output format
